observed_source_features: Locked canon has a compact swept segmented metal crown; overlapping dark plates keep a shaped outline, with a narrow lighter bronze supraoptic accent rather than a large uniformly pale roof.

July head detail separates plate edges, rivets, enclosed recessed circular optic, compound bill root, deep hooked bill and shaped recessed cheek opening; useful identity depends on geometry and depth as well as finish.
Full canon and First Choice frames maintain dark dense layered body metal, folded shield wings, compact inherited stance, and mechanically articulated legs and toes.
Maker and Mechanic references have dark optics. Advanced has a restrained orange awakened optic/core with inherited character continuity.
Era images vary in lighting, pose and visible finish; source-image luminance is not calibrated material reflectance.
source_gaps_from_previously_seen_loop02_: Original09 head held in Loop02 retained03 had a broad smooth pale crown/brow surface, thick rounded optic seat and a simpler rounded bill treatment compared with source interlocking enclosure.
Whole-character soft regular breast/feather relief and sparse mechanical leg/wing depth remain source resemblance gaps beyond a local crown appearance scope.
A local crown appearance gain can be useful development progress but cannot by itself establish full source likeness, photorealism, three-era differentiation completion, or owner acceptance.
predeclared_pixel_gates: Compare actual matched before/candidate whole neutral and workshop pairs in all three eras before opening claims or technical receipts.
At whole scale, crown change should reduce source-incongruent pale roof dominance or improve segmented metal reading in both lights, not just a tight crop or one dramatic light.
Require same-direction gain in all eras or explicitly bounded mixed result; check Maker/Mechanic dark optics and Advanced orange optic remain readable.

Check cost: lost optic/bill/plate readability, black featureless crown, broader apparent helmet mass, introduced bright rim or disconnected strips, material discontinuity with neck/body, distracting contrast, or lost era coherence.
Inspect requested selected opposite profile/rear after whole pairs for local continuity; do not infer unseen angles from a single canon view.
Record dominant residual geometry/material source gaps even when a local appearance gain is useful.
Do not turn stable cameras, hashes, counts, material bindings, or aggregate RGB differences into an artistic acceptance verdict.
